title: JANUS Linear A SigLA word-view structural schema probe specification

canonical_structural_signature.element_component: lowercase tag plus sorted dot-prefixed class names; ids, text, href targets and all other attributes excluded
canonical_structural_signature.path: relative ancestry path beginning at the unique document-view element
canonical_structural_signature.text_handling: visible non-whitespace text contributes only leaf count and character-count summaries; literal text is not used for candidate ranking
canonical_structural_signature.navigation_shape: anchors whose href basename matches ^index-[0-9]+\.html$ are counted as previously observed sign-selector-route-shaped descendants without assigning lexical meaning

mechanical_candidate_families.COMMON_PATH: relative structural path exists at least once in all three frozen pages
mechanical_candidate_families.COMMON_REPEATED_PATH: COMMON_PATH with occurrence count >=2 on at least one page; no claim that repetition is a word boundary
mechanical_candidate_families.COMMON_SELECTOR_BEARING_PATH: COMMON_PATH for which every page has at least one descendant anchor matching index-N.html route shape
mechanical_candidate_families.COMMON_SIBLING_SIGNATURE: same parent-relative-path plus same direct-child element signature occurs under the frozen document-view container in all three pages

ranking.primary: candidate family priority COMMON_SELECTOR_BEARING_PATH then COMMON_REPEATED_PATH then COMMON_PATH

forbidden: do not call any structural candidate a word, sign, morpheme or lexical unit
do not use literal transcription text for candidate selection
do not access mwenge transcription content
do not fetch live SigLA pages
do not add CSS selectors after seeing desired transcription output
do not collapse punctuation, fractions, numerals or uncertainty markers
do not promote three-page structural recurrence to universal SigLA schema
success_gate: The exact frozen artifact validates; all three word-view snapshots contain exactly one document-view container; structural observables are emitted deterministically; common candidate families are derived only by the frozen rules; scientific claim ceiling remains false.
next_if_successful: Freeze the smallest content-extraction grammar justified by the structural candidate result, then validate that grammar on a separately hash-selected interface-validation subset before any mwenge comparison.
